text: 最近算了一下，我的资产已经超过5000万了，都是自己赚的。
en: Recently I did a calculation, and my assets have already exceeded 50 million, all earned by myself.

text: 资产每年都在增加，如果运气好的话，将来可以超过一个小目标。
en: My assets increase every year; if I am lucky, they could surpass a small target in future.

text: 工作比较稳定，收入不错，也不太累，大方向我是整体看好的。
en: My job is fairly stable, the income is decent, and it is not too tiring; overall I am optimistic about the general direction.

text: 我没有负债，个人消费并不高，对奢侈品也没有特殊爱好，所以没什么生存压力。
en: I have no debts, my personal spending is not high, and I have no particular interest in luxury goods, so I am under little survival pressure.

text: 我的个子高，头发浓密，体脂率低，保持了健身习惯和健康饮食习惯，所以还比较健康，比同龄人看起来明显年轻，陌生人会以为我是90后。
en: I am tall, have thick hair, low body fat, and have maintained a fitness habit and a healthy diet, so I am fairly healthy, look noticeably younger than my peers, and strangers take me for a post-90s.

text: 颜值和穿搭都在线，这年龄还有人夸我帅哥，也满足了。
en: My looks and outfits are on point, and at this age people still call me a handsome man, so I am content.

text: 最近我比以前更重视健康，更加自律，目标是健康活100岁以上。
en: Lately I have valued health more than before and become more self-disciplined; my goal is to live healthily past 100.

text: 几年前离婚了，和平分手。
en: I divorced a few years ago; it was an amicable separation.

text: 我和前妻素质都比较高，但喜好和追求不同，做普通朋友更合适。
en: My ex-wife and I are both fairly refined, but our preferences and pursuits differ, so being ordinary friends suits us better.

text: 离婚对我的伤害和影响并不大，对女儿也基本没影响。
en: The divorce did not hurt or affect me much, and basically had no effect on my daughter.

text: 我并不为失败的婚姻而后悔，因为已经比那些鸡飞狗跳和浑浑噩噩的大部分更差的婚姻好多了，相比很多人婚姻中的各种不幸，我挺好的。
en: I do not regret the failed marriage, because it was already far better than most of those chaotic and muddled, worse marriages, and compared with the various misfortunes in many people's marriages, I am doing quite well.

text: 女儿跟前妻一起生活，和我关系也很好，比较喜欢和我玩。
en: My daughter lives with my ex-wife and has a good relationship with me; she rather enjoys playing with me.

text: 女儿刚上初中，成绩班里第一，颜值也第一。
en: My daughter has just started junior high; she is top of her class in grades, and also top in looks.

text: 女儿性格和我很像，不卷，理性，谨慎，从不生气，喜欢一些小刺激。
en: My daughter's personality is like mine — she does not get caught up in the rat race, is rational, cautious, never gets angry, and likes a bit of stimulation.

text: 女儿很好带，不用嘱咐学习也不用报辅导班。
en: My daughter is easy to raise — no need to remind her about studying, nor to enrol her in tutoring classes.

text: 她的颜值、智商、性格，让我很放心，她将来大概率会过得挺好。
en: Her looks, intelligence and personality reassure me; she will most likely live quite well in future.

text: 父母年龄大了，虽然身体不如从前，但比同龄人年轻。
en: My parents are getting on in years; although their health is not what it was, they are younger than their peers.

text: 两边家族都比较长寿，所以我觉得他们起码健康活到90岁以上。
en: Both sides of the family are fairly long-lived, so I think they will at least live healthily past 90.

text: 父母比较传统，在老家生活。
en: My parents are fairly traditional and live in our hometown.

text: 他们性格都很好，一辈子没吵架过，也从不给我压力，边界感很强。
en: They both have good temperaments, have never quarrelled in their lives, never pressure me, and have a strong sense of boundaries.

text: 在父母身上，我也几乎不用操心。
en: With my parents, I hardly need to worry either.

text: 我培养了一些健康的长期爱好，比如健身、唱歌、历史、写作等，这些爱好都是可以伴随一辈子的。
en: I have developed some healthy long-term hobbies, such as fitness, singing, history and writing; these are hobbies that can last a lifetime.

text: 无聊空虚的时候我也会打游戏看视频，有人一起玩的时候我可以去玩任何东西，对于新事物保持开放的态度。
en: When I feel bored or empty I also play games and watch videos; when there is someone to play with I can do anything, and I keep an open attitude towards new things.

text: 将来我应该还会培养几个新的健康爱好。
en: In future I will probably develop a few new healthy hobbies.

text: 健康是指，输出型+可持续+可精进。
en: Healthy means: output-oriented + sustainable + open to refinement.

text: 整体上，我对我当前的状态还是比较满意的。
en: Overall, I am fairly satisfied with my current state.

text: 我没什么压力和痛苦，在网上看到的别人的各种烦恼，我几乎都没有。
en: I have little stress or suffering; almost none of the various troubles of others I see online apply to me.

text: 虽然在年龄上，我已经是中年人了，但在心理和追求上，我并不想受到什么限制。
en: Although I am already middle-aged in years, mentally and in my pursuits I do not want to be constrained.

text: 我仍有一些追求，对于“更好”的追求。
en: I still have some pursuits — the pursuit of “better”.

text: 我的追求是长期而轻松的，不求一定获得什么特定结果，对我来说，做正确的事情并长期认真做 更重要，而收获只是副产品。
en: My pursuit is long-term and relaxed; I do not insist on achieving any particular result. For me, doing the right thing and doing it seriously over the long run matters more, and the gains are merely a by-product.

text: 众生畏果，菩萨畏因。
en: Ordinary beings fear the fruit; the bodhisattva fears the cause.

text: 提前思考和准备很重要。
en: Thinking and preparing ahead is important.

text: 当前的较好状态，来自于若干年前的提前布局和持续迭代；而现在的思考与改进，会在将来的若干年之后收益多多。
en: My current fairly good state comes from early planning and continuous iteration years ago; and the thinking and improvement I do now will yield rich returns many years into the future.

text: 做时间的朋友，将来美好的事情还有很多，世界也会越来越美好。
en: Be a friend of time; there are still many wonderful things to come, and the world will become ever more beautiful.

text: 84年生人，40岁。
en: Born in 1984, aged 40.

text: 年轻时没努力，毕业于一所双非大学的普通专业，本科，农村出来的，家境普通，干啥都是随大流，毕业来到了北京，和当时的男朋友现在的老公一起打工。
en: In my youth I did not strive; I graduated with a bachelor's degree from an ordinary major at a non-elite university (neither a Project 211 nor a 985 institution), came from the countryside, with an ordinary family background, and followed the crowd in everything. After graduating I came to Beijing and did odd jobs with my then boyfriend, now husband.

text: 研究生没想过，公务员没重视。
en: I never considered postgraduate study, and did not value civil service.

text: 毕业十几年来，在房地产评估公司，房地产中介公司上过班，中间还因为没人帮看孩子，全职了五六年。
en: In the dozen-plus years since graduating I have worked at a property valuation company and a property agency; in between, because no one could help look after the child, I was a full-time mother for five or six years.

text: 我老公是大学期间认识，同龄，都是原配初婚，人比较踏实节俭，没有任何不良嗜好，每月发了工资就会转给我，没怎么吵过架，家庭还算和谐。
en: I met my husband during university; we are the same age, each other's first and only spouse, and he is steady and frugal, with no bad habits. Every month when his salary arrives he transfers it to me; we have hardly ever quarrelled, and the family is fairly harmonious.

text: 2012年生了老大，儿子，现年12岁；2019年生了老二，儿子，现年5岁。
en: Our first child, a son, was born in 2012 and is now 12; our second, also a son, was born in 2019 and is now 5.

text: 这一路跌跌撞撞被社会毒打，无头苍蝇的走了过来。
en: Along the way I stumbled and was brutally battered by society, blundering through like a headless fly.

text: 夫妻名下三套房，北京两套，天津一套，都不是什么核心地段的优质房子，一套自住，另外两套出租。
en: In the couple's name are three properties: two in Beijing, one in Tianjin; none are quality homes in prime locations. One is for self-occupancy, the other two are rented out.

text: 其中按揭贷款加起来有13000。
en: The mortgage payments on them add up to 13,000.

text: 目前两人总收入在四万五左右，主要是老公占大头。
en: Currently the couple's total income is around forty-five thousand, mainly from the husband.

text: 目前存款不足五万，日常消费拼多多，从来不去商场买衣服，尤其从去年开始在外面吃饭的时候都很少了。
en: Current savings are under fifty thousand; for daily spending we use Pinduoduo, never buy clothes at malls, and especially since last year we rarely eat out.

text: 虽然生活节俭，但是一年到头就是存不下来钱。
en: Although we live frugally, we just cannot save any money by year's end.

text: 2014年至2016年我老公创业了两三年，投入不多，但是也没什么收入，折腾了两三年又去企业上班，如今在一家民营企业做到中层管理，
en: From 2014 to 2016 my husband ran a business for two or three years; the investment was not large but there was little income, so after messing about for two or three years he went back to working at a company, and now he has reached middle management at a private enterprise,

text: 每天加班，很辛苦，因为老大小时候没用心陪伴，导致孩子各方面能力都很差，还被医院诊断有“多动症”，我从2018年辞掉工作陪他，
en: working overtime every day, which is very hard. Because we did not accompany our eldest attentively when he was little, the child's abilities in every respect are poor, and a hospital diagnosed him with “ADHD”. I quit my job in 2018 to be with him,

text: 此后长达五年的时间我坚持辅导他学习，费心费力，学习依然毫无起色，基本每次考试都是班里最后一名的成绩，目前对他的学习已经看开，
en: and for the five years thereafter I persistently tutored him, exhausting effort and care, yet his studies showed no improvement; he was basically last in class in every exam. I have now come to terms with his studies,

text: 引导其他方面，希望他以后能做个有用的人。
en: and instead guide him in other aspects, hoping he can become a useful person in future.

text: 我比较晚熟，真正醒悟是在38岁以后，对自己的职业,对家庭的将来,对孩子的学业,才有了一个通透的认知，经历了三年疫情，感悟还是体制内工作好，但是为时已晚，对于未来也比较迷茫，我身无长技，老公也是服务型行业，没有技能傍身，中间也尝试买理财，炒股都因为不够专业，失败告终，好在没有很大的损失。
en: I am a late bloomer; I only truly woke up after 38, gaining a clear understanding of my career, my family's future and my child's education. Having lived through three years of the pandemic, I realised that work within the system is best, but it was too late; I am also fairly lost about the future. I have no real skills, and my husband is in the service industry with no skills to fall back on either. Along the way we also tried wealth management and stock trading, both ending in failure through lack of expertise, though fortunately without major losses.

text: 我很长一段时间都非常悲观，所幸老公是个有钝感力同时又很乐观的人，在我低落的时候鼓励我，从来没有说过扫兴的话，这大概是我们小家一直稳定的基础，我中间也接触了几年的心理学，深感情绪稳定对一个家庭和谐的作用十分重大。
en: For a long time I was very pessimistic; fortunately my husband is a person who, though rather insensitive, is also very optimistic, and who encouraged me when I was low and never said anything dispiriting — this is probably the foundation of our little family's stability. In between I also engaged with psychology for a few years, and deeply felt how vital emotional stability is to a family's harmony.

text: 今年过年回家，和同学聚会后感悟很深，我们在北漂的这十几年，老家的同学也在努力拼搏中，区别是人家为自己的事业而奋斗，而我们就一直在企业打工，形成了很保守很固化的思维，现在比较来看，更羡慕他们有初具规模的事业，为自己事业努力拼搏的那种状态，而我们现在是想动不敢动，瞻前顾后，迷茫焦虑。
en: This year, going home for the New Year and meeting classmates, I was deeply moved. During our dozen-odd years as Beijing drifters, our classmates back home were also striving hard; the difference is they fought for their own careers, while we just worked for companies the whole time, forming very conservative, fixed ways of thinking. Comparing now, I envy them more for having budding careers and that state of striving for their own endeavours, whereas we now want to act but dare not, hesitating and looking ahead and behind, confused and anxious.

text: 双方父母健在，我的父母年龄较大，公婆未到70，身体情况都尚可，我的父母有退休金，公婆还有另一个儿子，老公哥哥也是非常孝顺，所以养老方面金钱压力不是很大。
en: Both sets of parents are alive. My parents are older; my in-laws are under 70, and all are in fair health. My parents have pensions; my in-laws also have another son, and my husband's brother is very filial, so the financial pressure of elderly care is not great.

text: 夫妻两人目前有两个压力，一是老公四十岁，随时可能面临裁员，一旦失业，就只能从事体力劳动，再就业的可能性不大。
en: The couple currently face two pressures. First, my husband is forty and could face redundancy at any time; once unemployed, he could only do physical labour, with little chance of re-employment.

text: 于是我俩日常就是在聊我们未来要去做什么。
en: So our daily conversation is just about what we will do in future.

text: 二是孩子教育，老大学习成绩很差，我经过几年对他情况的了解及分析，已经接受他未来上职高这个情况，但是上什么专业，以后做什么还是比较迷茫。
en: Second is the children's education. The eldest's grades are very poor; after years of understanding and analysing his situation, I have accepted that he will attend a vocational high school in future, but what major he will take and what he will do later still leaves me fairly lost.

text: 年纪大了，愈发胆子小了，我自己躺平状态，偶尔看一下要不要考个证，一想到我的学习能力，就没有继续，目前我的爱好就是周末户外活动，几乎每周六都带着俩孩子在徒步，希望他们最起码身体健健康康的，至于老公，还在努力的工作，多累压力多大，都不敢轻言离职。
en: Getting older, I have become more timid. I am myself in a lying-flat state; occasionally I wonder whether to sit a certificate exam, but the thought of my learning ability stops me. My current hobby is weekend outdoor activities; almost every Saturday I take the two children hiking, hoping at least they will be healthy in body. As for my husband, he is still working hard, and no matter how tired or how pressured, he dares not lightly speak of resigning.

text: 上有老下有小，前路漫漫，只能走一步看一步。
en: With the elderly above and the children below, the road ahead is long; we can only take it one step at a time.

text: 中年人，一起加油吧。
en: Middle-aged folks, let us keep going together.

text: 一个月左右的时间，家里发生了如此大的变化。
en: In about a month, such great changes have taken place at home.

text: 孩子马上小升初，网上报名是5.30-5.31，孩子上的小学本来直升的初中就在小区旁边，在5.27日得知那个学校上不了了，校方的解释，还是直升，还是那个学校，但是迁址了，新址在5公里外，还没有修盖完。
en: The child is about to move from primary to junior high. Online registration was 30–31 May; the junior high his primary school directly fed into was originally right next to our estate, but on 27 May we learned that that school was no longer an option. The school's explanation: it is still a direct progression, still that school, but it has relocated, to a new site 5 km away that is not yet finished being built.

text: 这对生活将产生很大的影响，第二天上午我工作进行不下去，一直看群消息。
en: This will greatly affect our life. The next morning I could not get on with work and kept checking group messages.

text: 到了中午，父亲体检的报告单出来了，父亲疑似癌症了。
en: At noon, my father's health-check report came out — he was suspected of having cancer.

text: 然后迅速把他资料传给医院的同学，同学说恶性肿瘤，已经扩散了。
en: I then quickly sent his records to a classmate at the hospital, who said it was a malignant tumour and had already spread.

text: 迅速决定回省会，带父亲去医院全面检查，同时关注孩子学校情况，虽然家长们都非常愤怒，据理力争，也惊动了公安局，但总归胳膊拧不过大腿，认了。
en: We quickly decided to return to the provincial capital and take my father to hospital for a full check-up, while keeping an eye on the child's school situation. Although the parents were all furious and argued their case, even alerting the public security bureau, in the end the arm cannot twist the thigh, so we accepted it.

text: 得知这个结果愤怒又无助，这边还要抓紧带着父亲各种检查。
en: Learning this result, we were angry yet helpless, and on this side still had to hurry to take my father for various tests.

text: 因为太忙，都来不及为父亲这个事儿难过。
en: Because we were too busy, there was no time even to feel sad about my father's condition.

text: 难过又有什么用呢，不如打起精神来带他尽快确定病症，找到治疗方法，稳定住病情。
en: But what use is sadness? Better to rally our spirits and take him to determine the illness quickly, find a treatment, and stabilise his condition.
